app.title: Show HN: RxFilm Studio–Create and edit your product videos with AI agent
app.author: zilue
app.description: RxFilm Studio is a web-based video editing platform that leverages an AI agent to assist with creation and editing of product videos.

proposed_tests.test: Open the web app and perform a simple video import
proposed_tests.objective: Verify UI loads and accepts media

proposed_tests.test: Use the AI agent to generate a storyboard
proposed_tests.objective: Confirm AI integration and output format

proposed_tests.test: Export the edited video and check file integrity
proposed_tests.objective: Ensure export pipeline works and produces valid media

proposed_tests.test: Measure load time of the dashboard with 10 videos queued
proposed_tests.objective: Benchmark UI performance under moderate load
